declaration: Frozen before any full-source factorial output. Earlier trace observed Mid->clean +0.714347 dB; no parameter or threshold fitting is authorized.

raw_original_source.selection: Existing project reference from the mission priority list; 131.115s fits qualified <=180s geometry and previous 1536MiB resource ceiling. No candidate-output search. Contrast to the first song is exploratory, not a measured genre classification.

method.channel: first channel only, matching assess.rs; not stereo maximum or average
method.transform: One whole-clip float64 NumPy real FFT per input, native-length periodic grid. Parseval weights: DC and even-N Nyquist one, all other bins two.
method.frequency_response: Combined squared amplitude response of dsp::lowpass(cutoff=2500, transition=500, slope=2) then highpass(cutoff=1000, transition=300, slope=2). Each gain = max(0, 0.5+0.5*cos(pi*clip(t,0,1)))**2; t=(f-2500)/500 for LP and (1000-f)/300 for HP.
method.rms: Broadband RMS from first-channel time samples; filtered RMS from Parseval. Both floored at 1e-8 as native before computing ratios.
method.absolute_shape_db: abs(signed_shape_db); compare descriptive crossing of unchanged native <1 dB rule
method.incremental: Signed change from preceding cached boundary, with separate filtered-band and broadband RMS changes; signed increments telescope but absolute deviations do not.
method.numerics: Analytical-response approximation only: NumPy complex128/float64 and Parseval differ from native sequential complex32 FFT/IFFT, f32 frequency/gain, and f32 reductions. Explicit final difference from native reported; no byte-native reproduction claim.
method.alignment: Exact declared rate/channel/frame geometry only. No waveform/event alignment test, shifts or fitting; temporal alignment unsupported. Whole-clip circular Fourier-power diagnostic, not a temporal preservation measure.

contrasts.requested_interaction: combined - denoise - EQ + raw_identity, separately for signed normalized shape dB, filtered-RMS change dB and broadband-RMS change dB
contrasts.guarded_interaction: same contrast with clean(false,false) guard-only baseline instead of raw identity, because all four function arms include final headroom protection
contrasts.main_differences: Each arm vs same cached Mid input, and vs decoded original source; no absolute-deviation arithmetic for interaction.

gates: All initial/source/module/tool/plan/build/binary hashes remain pinned; create-only outputs and artifact/run HALT/STOP latches.
Combined first: output.wav SHA must exactly equal frozen cached stage3_clean.wav before other arms or contrasts; otherwise STOP and preserve.

Raw identity byte hash equals Mid input; exact declared channel/rate/frame geometry; all samples finite; no shifts/resampling/search. Same-sample timeline is constructed by the native clean function; temporal preservation is not inferred from spectral metrics.
Native child sampled and self-reported HWM <=512 MiB, child <=180s, analysis <=512MiB, total <=900s. Native and numerical failures stop without retry.
Analytical Parseval closure relative error <=1e-10, finite/floored RMS status retained; original native gate never replaced.
interpretation: One source/one frozen input, no population or audible-cause claim. D contains high-band plus quiet dual-zone mid denoise; EQ follows D and depends on its spectral/quietness statistics.

Every clean-function arm includes the final global 0.99 peak guard even when D=E=false, whereas native auto-master bypasses clean in that case. Global pre-guard peaks/gains in D/E/combined are not instrumented; raw/post peaks and guard-only known scale retained.
Uniform positive guard gain cancels above the RMS floors in the normalized analytical proxy, modulo f32 rounding; raw RMS changes remain guard-confounded.
No production change, training, speed experiment, parameter fitting, gate relaxation, mastering-candidate render or new listening package. Original failed run remains latched.
outputs: raw ignored runs contain five WAVs, native receipts/logs and frozen example binary
